Gossip message layouts, size bounds, and encode and parse helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines private data structures, constants, and helper functions for the gossip protocol encoding and parsing code. It sets size limits for CRDS values, message types, and value tags, and it provides view structs that map decoded payload bytes to fields for pull requests, pull responses, push messages, prune messages, ping, and pong. The file also declares utility functions for parsing gossip messages, building pull request payloads, and encoding contact info and vote CRDS values. It includes small inline helpers for reading contact info sockets and for converting time values between nanoseconds, microseconds, and milliseconds.
